statement: An operator subject to the COPPA Rule is required to obtain verifiable parental consent before any collection, use, or disclosure of personal information from children, defined as individuals under the age of 13, including consent to any material change in the collection, use, or disclosure practices to which the parent has previously consented (16 C.F.R. § 312.5(a)(1), § 312.2).
caveat: The rule binds operators of websites and online services directed to children and operators with actual knowledge they are collecting or maintaining personal information from a child (§ 312.3); § 312.5(b) prescribes the acceptable consent methods and § 312.5(c) lists the exceptions, and the FTC enforces the rule under the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act. Verified against the eCFR compilation current as of 2026-10-15; recheck the live text before relying. This repo does not determine whether a service is directed to children.
